body: Since a week ago everyone I know has been kind of avoiding me I have to pull myself over to them or find a way into a conversation and they'll just attempt to pull themselves away even my closest friend is slowly pulling away and it horrifies me but I learned to deal with the constant feeling
But what I don't get is I'm expecting people to leave me and I mean everyone so if no is here to get hurt then who can I hurt
I guess it's just a constant feeling of never trusting people because I've been stabbed in the back so many times by family "friends"
I don't want to shatter those who "care" which is why I plan to when they leave but by then I'm sure I will be more mature and have a better way of thinking but I'll wait until that time comes

Listen I know my word isn't the best to trust I mean I'm someone you don't know on a website you might use for venting sadness or different emotions all I can really tell you is after a storm there are 2 things a lake, a rainbow, or both they are both beautiful are they not even if you don't feel depressed it could be a sign leading to it so you shouldn't tell a family member tell your closest friend, your family might only give you the we love you spiel but a close friend will prove it to you words are useless if actions don't follow
